title: Enrollment Switched From AC to Battery Power
description: Detects that the device lost AC power and switched to battery while the enrollment was running (power_state_change event with transition ac_to_battery from the agent's live power watcher). Uses a single required condition so the match is pinned to one event instance; the event payload carries the battery percentage at the moment of the switch. The agent debounces power flapping (5s) so a brief unplug/replug does not produce this event.
explanation: The device switched from AC to battery power mid-enrollment. Enrollments are power-hungry — app downloads, Windows Update and disk encryption drain a battery quickly, and Windows may also throttle CPU and network on battery, slowing the enrollment down. The battery percentage at the moment of the switch is recorded on the matched power_state_change event in the session timeline; if the device stayed on battery, look there for subsequent threshold events (50/30/15%) — a later battery_to_ac event means power was restored.

remediation.title: Restore AC power
steps: Reconnect the device to AC power; the enrollment continues normally.
Check the session timeline for a subsequent battery_to_ac event (power restored) or threshold_crossed events (battery draining) to judge urgency.
If this alert is frequent in a deployment area, check docking stations/USB-C hubs for loose power delivery — a flapping dock is a common cause.
Make 'plugged in during setup' part of the end-user/technician enrollment instructions.
